title: Kimi Chatbot Maker Moonshot AI Valued at $20 Billion in Meituan-Led Round
title_zh: Kimi 聊天机器人制造商 Moonshot AI 在美团领投的一轮融资中估值达 200 亿美元
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Moonshot AI has raised about $2 billion in its latest funding round, signaling growing investor appetite for Chinese startups rivaling Silicon Valley’s leaders.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——Moonshot AI 在最新一轮融资中筹集了约 20 亿美元，这表明投资者对与硅谷领先企业竞争的中国初创企业的兴趣日益浓厚。

title: Top Trump Aide Says Administration Won’t Pick Winners in AI Race
title_zh: 特朗普高级助手表示政府不会选出人工智能竞赛的获胜者
summary: (Bloomberg) -- White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles said the US government would refrain from choosing winners and losers in artificial intelligence, the latest signal from a top aide to President Donald Trump as his administration prepares new AI policy directives.Most Read...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——白宫办公厅主任苏西·威尔斯表示，美国政府将避免选择人工智能领域的赢家和输家，这是唐纳德·特朗普总统在政府准备新的人工智能政策指令之际，一名高级助手向他发出的最新信号。

title: Anthropic Is Making Its Claude Chatbot More Appealing to Consumers
title_zh: Anthropic 正在使其 Claude 聊天机器人对消费者更具吸引力
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic PBC, which originally aimed its Claude chatbot at businesses, is looking to capitalize on recent inroads with consumers by making the software more appealing to everyday people.Most Read from BloombergUS Has Opened a Pas...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——人工智能初创公司 Anthropic PBC 最初将其 Claude 聊天机器人瞄准了企业，现在正在寻求利用最近在消费者中取得的进展，使该软件对普通人更具吸引力。彭博美国的大多数读者已经打开了一个 Pas...

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures trade flat as investors watch for US-Iran deal
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货交易持平，投资者关注美伊协议
summary: Major gauges held steady as markets adjusted to the potential of peace in Iran.
summary_zh: 随着市场根据伊朗和平的潜力进行调整，主要指标保持稳定。

title: 'Uber won': Why Instacart might not stand a chance
title_zh: “Uber 获胜”：为什么 Instacart 可能没有机会
summary: Uber (UBER) and Maplebear (CART) (Instacart's parent company) both reported quarterly earnings on Wednesday.
summary_zh: Uber (UBER) 和 Maplebear (CART)（Instacart 的母公司）均于周三公布了季度收益。

title: Meta-Backed Scale AI Wins $500 Million Defense Department Deal
title_zh: 元支持的规模人工智能赢得国防部 5 亿美元的交易
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The Pentagon awarded a $500 million contract to Meta Platforms Inc.-backed Scale AI to help sift through data and assist in decision-making, the latest step in the US military’s effort to rely more on artificial intelligence.Most Read from BloombergUS Has Opened...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——五角大楼向 Meta Platforms Inc. 支持的 Scale AI 授予了一份价值 5 亿美元的合同，以帮助筛选数据并协助决策，这是美国军方更多地依赖人工智能的最新举措。彭博社的大多数报道已经开放……

title: Arm forecasts higher-than-expected revenue on surging AI data center demand
title_zh: 由于人工智能数据中心需求激增，Arm 预计收入高于预期
summary: Arm Holdings forecast first-quarter revenue above Wall Street expectations on Wednesday, benefiting from higher adoption of its chip technology as tech companies spend heavily on artificial intelligence compute.
summary_zh: Arm Holdings 周三预测第一季度收入将高于华尔街预期，这得益于科技公司在人工智能计算上投入巨资，其芯片技术的采用率更高。

title: AMD stock surges as the chipmaker forecasts continued AI growth
title_zh: AMD 股价飙升，芯片制造商预测人工智能将持续增长
summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) stock surges higher on Wednesday after blowing past first quarter earnings estimates and second quarter guidance forecasts.
summary_zh: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) 股票周三飙升，此前第一季度盈利预期和第二季度指导预测均超出预期。

title: Samsung market cap crosses $1 trillion amid memory chip rally
title_zh: 内存芯片上涨 三星市值突破1万亿美元
summary: Samsung Electronics (005930.KS, SMSN.IL) reached a $1 trillion market cap on Wednesday as the memory chip shortage drives the hardware manufacturer — and other memory chip developers — even higher.
summary_zh: 三星电子 (005930.KS, SMSN.IL) 周三市值达到 1 万亿美元，因为存储芯片短缺导致硬件制造商和其他存储芯片开发商股价进一步上涨。
